questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "The boys ___ playing in the ground."
questions.explanation: The subject "boys" is plural, so the verb is "are".

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "She ___ a doctor."
questions.explanation: A singular subject takes "is".

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "Ravi and Raju ___ friends."
questions.explanation: Two subjects joined by "and" take a plural verb.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "The news ___ true."
questions.explanation: "News" is an uncountable noun that takes a singular verb.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "Each of the students ___ present."
questions.explanation: "Each" is singular, so it takes "is".

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "My friends ___ coming to the party."
questions.explanation: The plural subject "friends" takes "are".

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "Neither of the two answers ___ correct."
questions.explanation: "Neither" is singular, so the verb is "is".

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "Either Ravi or his brothers ___ responsible."
questions.explanation: With "either-or", the verb agrees with the nearer subject. "His brothers" is plural, so "are".

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "The team ___ planning its strategy."
questions.explanation: The team acts as one unit, so the singular verb "is" is used.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "Mathematics ___ my favourite subject."
questions.explanation: "Mathematics" ends in -s but names one subject, so it takes a singular verb.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "The number of students ___ increasing."
questions.explanation: "The number of" is singular, so it takes "is".

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "One of my friends ___ a pilot."
questions.explanation: The subject is "one", which is singular.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "Bread and butter ___ my usual breakfast."
questions.explanation: "Bread and butter" is thought of as one dish, so the verb is singular.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "Neither the teacher nor the students ___ present."
questions.explanation: With "neither-nor", the verb agrees with the nearer subject. "The students" is plural, so "were".

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "He is one of those boys who ___ always late."
questions.explanation: The relative pronoun "who" refers to "boys" (plural), so the verb is "are".

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "The quality of the products ___ improved."
questions.explanation: The head noun is "quality" (singular), so "has" is used.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "Ten kilometres ___ a long distance to walk."
questions.explanation: A distance considered as a whole takes a singular verb.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "Not only the players but also the coach ___ injured."
questions.explanation: With "not only-but also", the verb agrees with the nearer subject, "the coach" (singular), so "was".

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "The scissors ___ on the table."
questions.explanation: "Scissors" is a plural-only noun, so it takes a plural verb.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "Each boy and each girl ___ a prize."
questions.explanation: With "each" before each noun, the subject is treated as singular, so "has".
